# MDDK.com

> > A comprehensive medical reference resource providing detailed information on diseases, conditions, anatomy, and clinical procedures for health education and diagnosis support.

MDDK.com is a medical encyclopedia offering evidence-based articles on clinical conditions, anatomical structures, diagnostic procedures, and treatment approaches. The site serves as a reference for understanding medical terminology, disease pathophysiology, and clinical examination techniques.

## Key Topics

- Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS)
- Respiratory failure
- Subscapularis muscle
- Antalgic gait
- Foramen magnum
- Superior vena cava
- Diuresis
- Sternum pain
- Nerve disorders
- Clinical diagnosis
- Anatomy reference
- Health conditions
- Medical encyclopedia
- Symptom guide
- Diagnostic terms

## Core Medical Directories

- [MDDK.com - Medical Information for your Health](https://mddk.com): Homepage offering medical articles, health news, and information on diseases, conditions, and anatomy.
- [Diseases and Conditions | Medical Articles](https://mddk.com/diseases-and-conditions): Directory of diseases and conditions including neurological, musculoskeletal, and respiratory disorders.
- [General Health | Medical Articles](https://mddk.com/general-health): General health reference covering symptoms, conditions, and medical information.
- [Skin Conditions | Medical Articles](https://mddk.com/skin-conditions): Medical reference on skin conditions including fungal infections and dermatological disorders.

## Neurological & Neurosurgical Reference

- [Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) - Mechanism, Types, Procedure](https://mddk.com/transcranial-magnetic-stimulation.html): Detailed guide to TMS mechanism, types, and clinical applications in neurology and psychiatry.
- [Foramen Magnum - Anatomy, Contents, Relations, Clinical Significance](https://mddk.com/foramen-magnum.html): Anatomical reference on foramen magnum, skull base, and craniovertebral junction.

## Anatomical & Musculoskeletal Reference

- [Subscapularis Muscle - Anatomy, Function, Innervation, Tears, Treatment](https://mddk.com/subscapularis-muscle.html): Comprehensive anatomical reference on subscapularis muscle, rotator cuff, and shoulder function.
- [Superior Vena Cava - Anatomy, Function, Variations, Significance](https://mddk.com/superior-vena-cava.html): Anatomical and clinical reference on superior vena cava and thoracic venous system.
- [Costovertebral Angle (CVA) - Anatomy, Location, Tenderness, Examination](https://mddk.com/costovertebral-angle.html): Clinical anatomy reference on costovertebral angle landmarks and kidney examination.
- [Coronal Plane - Definition, Anatomy, Movements, Imaging](https://mddk.com/coronal-plane-2.html): Anatomical reference on coronal plane, body orientation, and medical imaging terminology.

## Clinical Conditions & Symptoms

- [Respiratory Failure - Definition, Diagnosis, Treatment, Prevention](https://mddk.com/respiratory-failure.html): Clinical reference on respiratory failure pathophysiology, diagnosis, and treatment protocols.
- [Antalgic Gait - Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis, Treatment](https://mddk.com/antalgic-gait.html): Clinical guide to antalgic gait patterns, pain-related walking disorders, and diagnosis.
- [Sternum Pain - Prognosis, Causes, Prevention, Diagnosis, Management](https://mddk.com/5121.html): Medical reference on sternum pain causes, diagnosis, and management of chest wall pain.

## Renal & Urinary Physiology

- [Diuresis - Definition, Physiology, Types, Causes, Diagnosis, Treatment](https://mddk.com/diuresis.html): Medical reference on diuresis physiology, kidney function, and urine production mechanisms.

## Additional Resources

- [MDDK.com - Medical Information for your Health - Part 2](https://mddk.com/page/2): Second page of medical articles directory covering anatomy, conditions, and clinical information.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy - Medical Articles](https://mddk.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy outlining data collection, cookies, and third-party advertising practices.
